title: Likeable Person Test
description: How pleasant is your presence to others? Look at your warmth and social skills.

questions.lik_1: I easily make strangers or new people feel comfortable around me.
questions.lik_2: People often ask me for advice or confide in me about their personal problems.
questions.lik_3: I can laugh at my own silly mistakes without getting defensive or angry.
questions.lik_4: I often give others sincere compliments on their achievements or appearance.
questions.lik_5: When someone is talking, I give them my full attention instead of being busy with my phone.
questions.lik_6: I focus more on finding the good in people than on looking for their flaws.
questions.lik_7: I'm easy to work with in a team and rarely force my way.
questions.lik_8: I avoid interrupting when others haven't finished explaining something.
questions.lik_9: Others think I have a good sense of humor that doesn't put anyone down.
questions.lik_10: I really respect other people's opinions even when I see things differently.
questions.lik_11: When something goes wrong, I focus more on finding a solution than on blaming someone.
questions.lik_12: I easily remember small details of other people's lives (like their pet's name).
questions.lik_13: I usually show open, friendly body language (like a genuine smile and natural eye contact).
questions.lik_14: People often say my energy is positive and calming.
questions.lik_15: I always say please and thank you, even for small favors.
questions.lik_16: I find it easy to get along with people from backgrounds very different from mine.
questions.lik_17: I stay away from drama and avoid spreading gossip that hurts others.
questions.lik_18: When I succeed, I always remember and appreciate the people who helped me.

results.description: You tend to keep your distance, come across as cool, or may be hard for new people to approach.
You can be pleasant at certain times and within certain circles of friends.
You have strong empathy, get along easily, and radiate positive energy that people enjoy.
